description: City staff updated on winter snow removal and accessibility.
Clarified sidewalk clearing responsibilities for property owners.
Residents can report uncleared sidewalks to customer care.

chips.text: Committee members raised specific concerns about uncleared sidewalks at schools and river trails.
Uncleared sidewalks disproportionately affect people using wheelchairs and strollers.
Staff will add information on website about bylaw-compliant sidewalk clearing.

description: Discussed construction site accessibility and e-scooter hazards.
Administration to review low accessible pedestrian signal volumes.
BRT Planning Team to update on transit accessibility next meeting.

chips.text: Construction site accessibility impacts wheelchair and cane users.
Education and Awareness Subcommittee to draft a letter on construction accessibility.
